verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]By those beings who draw people to true faith vigorously,
w: by those beings who draw people to true faith

verses.en: [✲]And by those who tie their knots firmly,
[✲]And by those who glide along swiftly,
[✲]Then they advance and greatly excel others,
[✲]Then they manage the affair entrusted to them.
This will happen on the day when the quaking earth shall quake,
And a second quaking shall follow it.
On that day hearts will tremble,
And their eyes will be cast down —
They say, ‘Shall we really be restored to our former state?
‘What! even when we are rotten bones?’
They say, ‘Then that indeed would be a losing return.’
It will only be a single cry,
And behold! they will all come out in the open.
w: will all come out in the open

verses.en: Has the story of Moses reached thee?

verses.ar: اِذۡ نَادٰٮہُ رَبُّہٗ بِالۡوَادِ الۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًی ﴿ۚ۱۷﴾
verses.en: When his Lord called him in the holy Valley of Tuwa, saying,
“Go thou to Pharaoh; he has rebelled.

verses.ar: فَقُلۡ ہَلۡ لَّکَ اِلٰۤی اَنۡ تَزَکّٰی ﴿ۙ۱۹﴾
verses.en: “And say to him, ‘Wouldst thou like to be purified?
‘And I will guide thee to thy Lord so that thou mayest fear Him.’”
w: so that thou mayest fear Him

verses.en: So he showed him the great Sign,
But he rejected him and disobeyed.
Then he turned away from Moses, striving against him.
And he gathered his people and proclaimed,
Saying, ‘I am your Lord, the most high.’
So Allah seized him for the punishment of the Hereafter and the present world.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَعِبۡرَۃً لِّمَنۡ یَّخۡشٰی ﴿ؕ٪۲۷﴾
verses.en: Therein surely is a lesson for him who fears.

verses.ar: ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا اَمِ السَّمَآءُ ؕ بَنٰہَا ﴿ٝ۲۸﴾
verses.en: Are you harder to create or the heaven that He has built?
He has raised the height thereof and made it perfect.
And He has made its night dark, and has brought forth the morn thereof;
And the earth, along with it, He spread forth.
He produced therefrom its water and its pasture,
And the mountains, He made them firm.
All this is a provision for you and for your cattle.
But when the great disaster comes,
The day when man will call to mind all that he strove for,
And Hell will be made manifest to him who sees.
Then, as for him who rebels,
And who chooses the life of this world,
The Fire of Hell shall surely be his home.

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّہٖ وَنَہَی النَّفۡسَ عَنِ الۡہَوٰی ﴿ۙ۴۱﴾
verses.en: But as for him who fears to stand before his Lord, and restrains his soul from evil desires,
The Garden shall surely be his home.
They ask thee concerning the Hour: ‘When will it come?’
But what hast thou to do with the mentioning thereof?
The ultimate knowledge of it rests with thy Lord.
Thou art only a Warner unto him who fears it.

verses.ar: کَاَنَّہُمۡ یَوۡمَ یَرَوۡنَہَا لَمۡ یَلۡبَثُوۡۤا اِلَّا عَشِیَّۃً اَوۡ ضُحٰہَا ﴿٪۴۷﴾
verses.en: On the day when they see it, they will feel as if they had not tarried in the world but an evening or a morn thereof.
